calculators.description_native: Calculate monthly net take-home salary in Nigeria after statutory deductions including Personal Income Tax (PAYE under PITA), RSA Pension (8%), National Housing Fund (NHF 2.5%), and Consolidated Relief Allowance (CRA).

inputs.name: basic_salary
inputs.label_native: Monthly Basic Salary (₦ or leave 0 for standard 50% split)

inputs.name: housing_allowance
inputs.label_native: Monthly Housing Allowance (₦ or leave 0 for standard 30% split)

inputs.name: transport_allowance
inputs.label_native: Monthly Transport Allowance (₦ or leave 0 for standard 15% split)

inputs.name: deduct_nhf
inputs.label_native: Deduct National Housing Fund (2.5% of Basic)

calculators.formula_explanation:
1. Annual Gross Income: Converted to annual basis if monthly salary is entered.
2. Basic, Housing & Transport (BHT) Breakdown: If specific values are not provided, standard Nigerian payroll default splits are applied (Basic = 50%, Housing = 30%, Transport = 15% of Gross Income).
3. Statutory Pre-Tax Exempt Deductions:
   - Employee Pension Contribution = 8% of annual BHT (if enabled).
   - National Housing Fund (NHF) = 2.5% of annual Basic Salary (if enabled).
   - Life Assurance Premium = Actual annual premium paid.
4. Consolidated Relief Allowance (CRA):
   - CRA = Max(₦200,000, 1% of Gross Income) + (20% of Gross Income).
5. Total Tax Deductions = CRA + Pension + NHF + Life Assurance.
6. Chargeable / Taxable Income = Max(0, Gross Income - Total Tax Deductions).
7. Progressive Income Tax Bands under PITA (Personal Income Tax Act):
   - First ₦300,000 @ 7% (Max ₦21,000)
   - Next ₦300,000 @ 11% (Max ₦33,000)
   - Next ₦500,000 @ 15% (Max ₦75,000)
   - Next ₦500,000 @ 19% (Max ₦95,000)
   - Next ₦1,600,000 @ 21% (Max ₦336,000)
   - Excess over ₦3,200,000 @ 24%
8. Minimum Tax Override: Under PITA, if taxable income results in a calculated tax of less than 1% of Gross Income (or if taxable income is zero), a minimum tax of 1% of Gross Income is assessed.
9. Net Take-Home Pay (Annual) = Gross Income - PAYE Tax - Pension - NHF.
10. Monthly Net Take-Home = Annual Net Take-Home / 12.

calculators.description_native: Calculate Nigerian corporate tax obligations (CIT rate 0%, 20%, or 30%), Tertiary Education Tax (TETFund at 3%), and Withholding Tax credits under the latest Finance Act provisions.

inputs.name: gross_profit
inputs.label_native: Gross Operating Profit before Allowable Expenses (₦)

inputs.name: wht_credit_notes
inputs.label_native: Withholding Tax (WHT) Credit Notes Deducted at Source (₦)

calculators.formula_explanation:
1. Company Classification & Tax Rates (Finance Act 2020 / 2023):
   - Small Company (Turnover ≤ ₦25,000,000): CIT Rate = 0%, Tertiary Education Tax (TET) Rate = 0%.
   - Medium Company (Turnover ₦25,000,001 - ₦100,000,000): CIT Rate = 20%, TET Rate = 3% of Assessable Profit.
   - Large Company (Turnover > ₦100,000,000): CIT Rate = 30%, TET Rate = 3% of Assessable Profit.
2. Assessable Profit = Gross Profit - Tax-Deductible Operating Expenses.
3. Total Taxable Profit = Max(0, Assessable Profit - Capital Allowance).
4. Tertiary Education Tax (TETFund) = Assessable Profit × TET Rate (3% for medium and large companies).
5. Companies Income Tax (CIT) = Total Taxable Profit × CIT Rate (0%, 20%, or 30%).
6. Total Gross Corporate Tax Liability = CIT + TET.
7. Net Corporate Tax Payable to FIRS = Max(0, Total Gross Corporate Tax Liability - WHT Credit Notes).
8. Net Profit After Corporate Taxes = Assessable Profit - Total Gross Corporate Tax Liability.

calculators.description_native: Calculate official Corporate Affairs Commission (CAC) filing fees, FIRS Stamp Duty, name reservation, and legal perfection costs for Business Name or Private Limited (Ltd) company incorporation.

inputs.name: authorized_share_capital
inputs.label_native: Authorized Share Capital (₦) - Default ₦1,000,000 for standard local company

inputs.name: use_legal_practitioner
inputs.label_native: Accredited Legal / CAC Professional Agent Filing Fee

calculators.formula_explanation:
1. Business Name Registration (Sole Proprietorship / Partnership):
   - CAC Name Reservation Fee = ₦500.
   - CAC Official Registration Filing Fee = ₦10,000 fixed.
   - Electronic Status Report / Certificate = ₦5,000 (if selected).
   - FIRS Stamp Duty = ₦0 (Business Names do not carry share capital).
2. Private Limited Company (Ltd - Local / Foreign Owned):
   - CAC Name Reservation Fee = ₦500.
   - Statutory Share Capital Threshold Verification: Minimum ₦100,000 for local companies; Minimum ₦100,000,000 for foreign-owned companies (Ministry of Interior NIPC mandate).
   - CAC Incorporation Filing Fee: ₦10,000 for the first ₦1,000,000 share capital + ₦5,000 for every additional ₦1,000,000 share capital (or part thereof).
   - FIRS Stamp Duty on Share Capital: 0.75% of total Authorized Share Capital (e.g., ₦7,500 per ₦1,000,000 share capital).
   - CAC Electronic Certificate & Status Report = ₦5,000.
   - Professional Accreditation / Legal Agent Execution Fee = ₦35,000 (if selected).
3. Total Official Government Fees = Name Reservation + CAC Filing Fee + FIRS Stamp Duty + Status Report.
4. Total All-Inclusive Incorporation Cost = Total Official Government Fees + Legal/Agent Fee.

calculators.description_native: Calculate total legal fees, Governor's Consent fee, FIRS/State Stamp Duty, Capital Gains Tax, and registration perfection costs when buying or transferring real estate in Lagos State and across Nigeria.

inputs.name: property_value
inputs.label_native: Property Purchase Price / Assessed Market Value (₦)

calculators.formula_explanation:
1. Lagos State Title Perfection Rate Schedule (applied on assessed/fair market property value):
   - Governor's Consent Fee: 1.5% of Property Value.
   - Stamp Duty on Deed: 1.5% of Property Value.
   - Perfection Capital Gains Assessment: 0.5% of Property Value (under Lagos Land Registry schedule).
   - Land Registration Fee: 0.5% of Property Value.
   - Charting & Survey Verification Fee: ₦50,000 fixed assessment.
2. FCT Abuja & Other States Schedule:
   - Consent Fee: 2.0% - 2.5% of Property Value.
   - Stamp Duty: 1.5% of Property Value.
   - Registration Fee: 1.0% of Property Value.
3. Vendor Capital Gains Tax (CGT): 10% on net capital gains (if seller side liability is enabled).
4. Legal Conveyancing Attorney Fee = Property Value × Selected Legal Rate (5%, 7.5%, or 10%).
5. Real Estate Agent Commission = Standard 5% to 10% of Property Purchase Price.
6. Total Buyer Perfection & Legal Closing Cost = Consent Fee + Stamp Duty + Registration Fee + Charting Fee + Legal Conveyancing Fee.
7. Total Capital Required for Acquisition = Property Purchase Price + Total Buyer Perfection & Legal Closing Cost.

calculators.description_native: Calculate net Naira earnings for remote software engineers, freelancers, and contractors in Nigeria receiving foreign currencies (USD/EUR/GBP), factoring in FX conversion platforms (Grey, Geegpay, Payoneer), collection fees, and Nigerian Personal Income Tax (PIT).

inputs.name: fx_exchange_rate
inputs.label_native: FX Exchange Rate (NGN per 1 USD, e.g., ₦1,550)

inputs.name: client_type
options: Foreign Employer / Client (0% Local WHT Deducted)
Nigerian Corporate Client (5% WHT Deducted at Source)

calculators.formula_explanation:
1. Gross Annual USD Income = Monthly USD Income × 12.
2. Platform FX Fee Calculation:
   - Grey: 1.0% of Gross USD.
   - Geegpay: 0.9% of Gross USD.
   - Payoneer: 2.0% of Gross USD.
   - Direct Wire: Fixed ~$25/month ($300/year).
3. Net USD Received = Max(0, Gross USD Income - Platform Fees - (Monthly Work Expenses USD × 12)).
4. Gross NGN Income = Net USD Received × FX Exchange Rate.
5. Withholding Tax (WHT) Credit:
   - If Nigerian Corporate Client: 5% WHT deducted at source (serves as advance tax credit against annual PITA liability).
   - If Foreign Client: 0% WHT deducted at source.
6. Personal Income Tax (PITA Self-Assessment Calculation):
   - Consolidated Relief Allowance (CRA) = Max(₦200,000, 1% of Gross NGN) + 20% of Gross NGN.
   - Taxable Income = Max(0, Gross NGN - CRA).
   - Progressive PITA Tax calculated using standard Nigerian tax bands (7% to 24%).
7. Net Annual Tax Payable = Max(0, Calculated PITA Tax - WHT Tax Credits).
8. Net Monthly Take-Home in Naira = (Gross NGN Income - Net Annual Tax Payable) / 12.
